name: Northside Clinic
title: General practice
description: At Northside Clinic we are experienced in supporting the health and wellbeing of the trans, gender diverse and non binary people. Some Northside Clinic GPs start hormones for gender affirmation using the 'informed consent' model, which means that the GP does the mental health assessment first, then prescribes, unless the person has serious mental health issues that need to be addressed first. The practice nurses are available for further education regarding hormone therapy, including self-injecting technique for people taking testosterone. Patients aged under 18 years are usually seen at the Royal Children's Hospital Gender Clinic. (Clinic currently states it is not taking new patients.)
specialties: trans and gender diverse health, gender-affirming hormones, sexual health, HIV, LGBTIQA+ health

name: Dr Antje Theilhaber
title: Dr / Specialist General Practitioner
description: A doctor for over 25 years, Antje's broad medical expertise pairs well with her gentle approach to people of all backgrounds and stages of life. Antje is a proud member and strong supporter of the Rainbow Network. Special interests include Gender Affirming Health Care, sexual health and PrEP. Currently not accepting new patients (except antenatal shared care).
specialties: gender affirming health care, sexual health, PrEP, women's health, antenatal shared care

name: Dr Eunice Sales
title: Dr / Specialist General Practitioner
description: Dr Sales has a special interest in sexual and reproductive health, PrEP, travel medicine, preventative medicine and chronic conditions. She also provides HIV Medicine and is a S100 medication prescriber. Currently accepting new patients for HIV treatment and Gender affirming care. Eleanor Clinic asks new patients seeking gender affirming care (which can include access to hormone therapy) to book a 'New Patient - Gender Affirming Care' appointment.
specialties: gender affirming care, HIV medicine (S100 prescriber), PrEP, sexual and reproductive health

name: Dr Julie Carlile
title: Dr / General Practitioner (MBBS, FRACGP)
description: Inclusive & Gender-Affirming Care: Dr Julie is a proud supporter of the LGBTQIA+ community and is pleased to provide ongoing gender-affirming care, offering a safe, respectful, and inclusive space for all patients. She also has extensive experience caring for neurodivergent patients and in women's health.
specialties: gender-affirming care, women's health, ADHD/neurodiversity, skin health, paediatrics

name: Dr Caroline Cousins
title: Dr / Specialist GP (MBBS, FRACGP)
description: Dr Caroline Cousins is a warm, thoughtful, and experienced Specialist GP who brings a patient-centred, inclusive approach to every consultation. Her listed special interests include continuation of gender affirming hormone therapy, reproductive and sexual health, and PrEP.
specialties: continuation of gender affirming hormone therapy, women's health, reproductive and sexual health, PrEP
